description: A substantial opaque deep plum-purple floor-length gown with a low square neckline, fitted structured bodice, elbow-length sleeves, and broad gold woven floral and geometric borders along the neckline, sleeve ends, center front and skirt edges. Decorative gold clasps with purple stones sit at the shoulders, and a matching jeweled belt encircles the waist. An opaque cream underdress is visible through the open front skirt. A cream wrap with purple-gold patterned edging drapes along the forearms and down both sides. Small dangling gold-purple earrings and a patterned gold-colored closed shoe are visible. No armor, head covering or weapon is present.
